fields.description: Default maximum AC installations (units, not orders) per day when no date-specific override exists.
fields.label: Global AC Daily Capacity

fields.description: Disable same-day slots starting less than this many hours from now (a slot starting exactly at now + lead time is also disabled).
fields.label: Slot Lead Time Hours

fields.description: How many days ahead the POS offers delivery dates.
fields.label: Booking Window (Days)

fields.description: An item is an AC when its Item Group is one of these groups or any group under them.
fields.label: AC Item Groups

fields.description: Groups (and their children) under an AC group that must NOT consume AC installation capacity, e.g. accessories.
fields.label: Excluded Item Groups

fields.description: Single items inside the AC groups that are not installations (e.g. gas refill).
fields.label: Excluded Items
AC Rule Note
fields.options: Excluded lines are AC accessories: they travel with the AC installation when the order has AC units, and need a normal delivery slot only when the order has no AC unit.

fields.description: Warehouse that serves delivery Orders. Serials and stock for Orders are taken from here.
fields.label: Main Store (Delivery Orders)
AC Tech Max Orders per Day
fields.description: How many AC orders one AC Tech can take on one day. 0 = no limit. Exceptions per technician and day are in the AC Tech Day Limits table below.

fields.label: Delivery Charge Item
fields.description: Added once to a POS order when it contains an item with Has Delivery Charge ticked. Must be a non-stock item with a price in the POS price list.

fields.label: TV Driver Gap (Hours)
fields.description: A TV driver is busy for this many hours before and after each of his orders. Used when a Delivery Manager assigns.

fields.label: TV Driver Gap for System Manager (Hours)
fields.description: The same gap when a System Manager assigns (the old admin window).

fields.label: AC Tech Day Limits
fields.description: A different limit for one AC Tech on one day, instead of AC Tech Max Orders per Day. 0 = day off. Also editable from the Driver Assignment page (AC tab).

fields.label: Create Delivery Note when a Sales Order is submitted
fields.description: Replaces the server script "Delivery Note From Sales Order": a draft Delivery Note is made from every submitted Sales Order (once).

fields.label: Technician Visit Gap (Minutes)
fields.description: A technician is unavailable this many minutes before and after another visit on the same day.

fields.label: Default Service Person
fields.description: Service Person on Maintenance Visits made from the Technician page, when the technician has no Sales Person of his own.

fields.label: TV Rule Note
fields.options: A POS sale gets one TV account per unit of a TV Item, or of an item in a TV Item Group (sub-groups included) that is not an Excluded Item. The username and password are added to the notes of the invoice (and of the order). Orders made by hand in the desk get none.

fields.label: TV Account Note
fields.options: The accounts database (table lines). Leave the host empty to create no accounts.

fields.label: n8n Webhook URL
fields.description: POS sales are posted here with the invoice (and Delivery Note) PDF. Empty: nothing is sent.

fields.label: Send After (Minutes)
fields.description: Wait this long after the sale, so late changes are included.
